url.description: The base URL of the salt-api instance. Defaults to https://localhost:8080. Corresponds to -u/--saltapi-url.

timeout.description: Wait time in seconds before returning control to the shell. Corresponds to --timeout.

cache.description: File location for caching authentication tokens. Defaults to ~/.peppercache. Corresponds to -x.

ignore_ssl_errors.description: Set to 'yes' or 'true' to ignore SSL certificate errors. Corresponds to --ignore-ssl-errors.

verbose.description: Set to 'yes' or 'true' to enable verbose output. Corresponds to -v.
